back: Local: one model per series. Global: one model trained on the windows of many series together.
More training data per parameter, shared patterns are learned, short and new series work, one model to deploy.

front: Why must series be scaled in a global model?
back: Otherwise large series dominate the loss and the fit for small series is poor.

front: Why add a series id or static features?
back: So one model can tell series apart and learn series-specific behaviour.
A global model for most series, plus separate models or features for groups that behave differently.
